Our Story

A flower picked. A canvas filled. A memory kept.

I'm Kashika, and I started Bloom & Resin because I believe the most beautiful things in life deserve to last forever. A flower blooms for days — but the feeling it gives you? That should never fade.

Every resin piece I make begins with a real, living flower — pressed by hand, arranged with care, and sealed in crystal-clear resin so it stays just as beautiful as the day it was picked. Alongside that, I hand-paint original acrylic canvases — bold, abstract, and made to bring colour and life into your space.

No moulds. No duplicates. No prints. Every earring, every tray, every painting is entirely one of a kind — because that's what you deserve.
